Index: workspace/fetch.sh
===================================================================
--- workspace/fetch.sh	
+++ workspace/fetch.sh	
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -e
+
+API="https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/accelerators_accelerateurs-aws"
+
+fetch() {
+    local url="$1"
+    local outfile="$2"
+    local status
+    status=$(curl -s -L -o "$outfile" -w "%{http_code}" "$url")
+    if [ "$status" -ge 400 ]; then
+        echo "Retrying $url after 5s..."
+        sleep 5
+        status=$(curl -s -L -o "$outfile" -w "%{http_code}" "$url")
+    fi
+    echo "$status" > "${outfile}.status"
+}
+
+fetch "$API" /workspace/repo.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/" /workspace/root_contents.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/CONTRIBUTING.md" /workspace/contributing.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/.github/workflows" /workspace/workflows.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/.github/dependabot.yml" /workspace/dependabot_yml.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/.github/dependabot.yaml" /workspace/dependabot_yaml.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/renovate.json" /workspace/renovate.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/.renovaterc.json" /workspace/renovaterc.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/commits" /workspace/commits.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/issues?state=open" /workspace/issues.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/actions/runs" /workspace/actions_runs.json

You are an audit agent for the repository `TBS-OCIO-ESP` at `https://github.com/canada-ca/TBS-OCIO-ESP`.
Your job is to determine metadata and structural facts. Write the final results as a single JSON object to `/workspace/facts_TBS-OCIO-ESP.json`.

Determine the following fields with EXACTLY these allowed values. If you cannot determine a value, use exactly `Unknown`.

Fields to determine:
- `repo_name`: `TBS-OCIO-ESP`
- `repo_url`: `https://github.com/canada-ca/TBS-OCIO-ESP`
- `primary_language`: The language GitHub reports as primary (from API `language` field or the HTML repository page). If null, write `Unknown`.
- `readme_exists`: Check if a README file exists (API endpoint `contents` for root, or look at the file list on the repo page). Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
- `licence`: Check the license via API `license.spdx_id` or by reading the LICENSE file. If none or undetermined, `Unknown`. Use short name like `MIT`, `Apache-2.0`, `OGL-Canada`, etc.
- `contributing_guide`: Check if `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists at repo root (via API or file list). Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
- `has_security_scanning_in_ci`: Check GitHub Actions workflows. If no `.github/workflows` directory or no workflow files, write `No CI`. If workflow files exist, check the GitHub Actions tab for run history. If zero runs ever (e.g., Actions disabled), write `No CI`. If runs exist but none include a security scanner (CodeQL, npm audit, pip-audit, Snyk, Trivy), write `No`. If at least one run includes a scanner, write `Yes`. Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`No CI`/`Unknown`.
